items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: And I said, you know lady, my name is Sarah Parker. Sarah Williams, rather.

ctx.x: But, uh, my, uh, mother gave me to my godmother when I was two or three months old. And my mother didn't see me no more until I was 19. Oh, I see. Uh-huh. And I see. When my godmother gave her a back when the boy, my mother had done moved. Well, she went and couldn't locate her, you see. Yes. And my mother didn't see me until I was 19 years old. Oh, right. And as she come to see me, I met my older sister on the home. On the 4th of March. The farmers used to parade there. The same as carnival. On the 4th of March.…
Oh, how old were you when you moved back to the city? Oh, I don't know.
